description: Per-window capability of the host's always-on-top session bar (design doc §13; ADR 0055). The bar exists so the person at this machine keeps the two controls that matter while the main window is minimized or in the tray: who is connected, and the revoke. It gets exactly those, plus the geometry command its own collapse tab needs and the one that raises the main window - everything else, including every grant, setting, file, clipboard and audit command, is absent rather than denied. Deliberately NOT `core:default`: the only core permission here is dragging its own undecorated frame, scoped to its own label. No wildcard entries.
